column1: # The hentaigana of 古活字データセット blocks whose 字母 several code points share (能: 𛂛 and 𛂜), by the block ID of the archive imported on 2026-09-11.
# The dataset states each block's kana and 字母 (CODH, doi:10.20676/00000416). Which code point a block's shape is was
# decided on 2026-11-25 by looking at every block beside the forms GenSeki Hentaigana Gothic and GenZui Sans draw and
# samples of the code points in CODH's 日本古典籍くずし字データセット (doi:10.20676/00000340). No reviewer has confirmed them.
# docs/reports/kokatsuji-forms.md gives the counts and the blocks left undecided.
